# Ledger demo

A synthetic double-entry ledger service with a small CLI. `python -m ledger --help` lists the command groups. Inputs are CSV journals under `data/journals/`; generated reports land in `reports/`. Unit tests use `python -m unittest`.

import argparse


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="ledger", description="Double-entry ledger")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    for name, purpose in (("balance", "show account balances"), ("post", "post a journal entry"), ("reconcile", "reconcile against a statement")):
        child = sub.add_parser(name, help=purpose)
        child.add_argument("path", nargs="?")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    print(f"{args.command}: ok")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
